entities.name: Umbris
entities.description: An ancient nightmare horror of shadows from Ulvenwald, Innistrad, that feeds on memories of sorrow.

entities.name: Ulvenwald
entities.description: Region of Innistrad from which Umbris comes.

entities.name: Taivas
entities.description: A man who a hundred years ago imprisoned Umbris in a magic circle and made a pact with it.

entities.name: Traublassen
entities.description: A village whose people had their sorrowful memories stolen by Umbris.

entities.name: Vytas
entities.description: Taivas' great-grandson, who hired Torens to investigate strange sounds.

entities.name: Torens
entities.description: An investigator carrying a sacred mace who was sent to Umbris as a sacrifice and instead freed it on new terms.

entities.name: Aleksandar
entities.description: A young boy who helped Torens and was possessed by Umbris.

entities.name: Devils
entities.description: Devils who served Umbris as their master and helped store stolen memories in jars.

events.summary: A hundred years earlier, Taivas imprisons Umbris in a magic circle and makes a pact: Umbris steals the villagers' sorrowful memories in exchange for human sacrifices.
events.quote: One hundred years ago Taivas imprisoned Umbris in a magic circle and made a pact with the entity.

events.summary: Vytas hires Torens to investigate strange sounds in an old building near Traublassen, unknowingly sending him to Umbris as a sacrifice.
events.quote: Unknowingly, Torens was sent to Umbris as a sacrifice.
The entity possessed the body of Aleksandar

events.summary: Umbris offers to remove Torens' painful memories; Torens refuses and destroys the circle with his sacred mace.
events.quote: Torens refused and destroyed the circle that held Umbris using his sacred mace.

events.summary: Torens strikes a new deal: Umbris must return the stolen memories and abandon Aleksandar, and Torens warns he will destroy it next time.
events.quote: the entity must return the stolen memories to the villagers and abandon Aleksandar

relations.note: Devils served Umbris as their master.
relations.quote: devils who served him as their master

relations.note: Imprisoned it, then made a pact with it.
relations.quote: One hundred years ago Taivas imprisoned Umbris in a magic circle

relations.note: Freed it but vowed to destroy it next time.
relations.quote: the next time they would meet Torens would destroy him
